name: in_string_list_and_not_in_set
query: select account, count(*) as n where account in ('Expenses:Food:Coffee', 'Expenses:Food:Alcohol', 'Expenses:Does:Not:Exist') and 'trip-chicago-2016' not in tags group by account order by account
notes: Value IN a parenthesized list, NOT IN over the tags set. Keywords are written in lower case.
